external_coverage.exact_statement: For a complete non-Archimedean field K, including trivial valuation, projective K-schemes have compact Hausdorff analytification; affine points are multiplicative seminorms extending the absolute value of K, with pointwise topology.

Every finite algebraic extension F of a complete non-Archimedean field H has a unique absolute value extending that of H and is complete for it. If H is trivially valued, this extended absolute value is trivial.

For projective geometrically reduced X over a complete non-Archimedean field K, including trivial valuation, and semiample rational L, continuous psh metrics admit uniform approximation by rational weighted FS metrics and smooth semipositive metrics.

For projective geometrically reduced n-dimensional X over a complete non-Archimedean field K, including trivial valuation, continuous psh metrics on semiample rational bundles have positive symmetric multiadditive mixed Radon measures of mixed intersection mass; uniform metric convergence implies weak measure convergence, and complete field extension satisfies the pushforward law.

For projective geometrically reduced X over a complete non-Archimedean field K, including trivial valuation, and semiample rational L, continuous relative Monge–Ampère energy satisfies the cocycle identity, shifts by c(L^n) when c is added to its first metric, is (L^n)-Lipschitz for the sum of the two sup distances, and is invariant under complete field extension.

Let K be a complete discretely valued field of residue characteristic zero, normalized by v_K(π)=1, and X/K smooth projective of dimension n. For rational model metrics on ample L_i, relatively generated on a common normal projective flat K°-model with special fiber ∑b_Q Q, the continuous mixed measure has coefficient b_Q deg_Q(ℒ_1|Q⋯ℒ_n|Q) at ord_Q/b_Q and total mass (L_1⋯L_n).

If A is a discrete valuation ring with uniformizer t and B is a finite étale A-algebra, then at every prime q of B above the maximal ideal of A, B_q is a discrete valuation ring and t remains a uniformizer; the ramification index is one.

Every reduced quasi-projective variety over a characteristic-zero field admits projective resolution by smooth-center blowups in a smooth ambient variety. On a smooth quasi-projective variety over such a field, nonzero coherent ideals admit principalization with simple normal crossings. These constructions can be compatible with smooth morphisms and separable field extensions and equivariant for group actions.

accepted_partial_scope: Every characteristic-zero trivially valued ground field, every smooth geometrically integral projective variety of arbitrary dimension and actual ample rational L. All-point actual PSH/E1 descent, genuine raw mixed operator/energy/weighted limits, actual potential compactness/envelopes/orthogonality/both-sign differentiation/locality/comparison, intrinsic all-E1 target equivalence and original-space attainment/every-solution uniqueness, arbitrary support and arbitrary decreasing nets. Dimension-zero direct statement retained.
residual_original_gaps: Nontrivially valued/non-discrete original field axis and its operator/compactness/envelope/variational hypotheses remain unproved. Separate214 completed-closure descent draft not granted by this review.
